Description

Live execution status. DONE is sticky: cleared by write-1, SOFT_RESET, or the next accepted START.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:5] - - - -
[4] DONE rw, woclr 0x0 -
[3] STALLED r - -
[2] COMPUTING r - -
[1] WEIGHTS_LOADED r - -
[0] BUSY r - -

Field Descriptions

DONE

Last result row written AND its write response received. W1C. Hardware set wins over W1C; SOFT_RESET clears DONE.

STALLED

Array frozen by output backpressure or memory wait (live level).

COMPUTING

Activations in flight: from first row issued until last result written.

WEIGHTS_LOADED

Weights (and bias) resident in the array and valid.

BUSY

Any work or memory transaction outstanding. Also high while a SOFT_RESET/ABORT flush finishes.
